# Ollama Recent Releases Summary

## Latest Releases

**v0.40.0** (September 25, 2026) - Pre-release
- "Models run on MLX on Apple Silicon by default"
- Model architectures supported by MLX runtime automatically execute on MLX for improved performance

- Structured outputs on thinking models now operate in a single pass for faster, more reliable results
- Resolved intermittent "model not found" errors affecting large local libraries
- Fixed macOS app unresponsiveness when checking ChatGPT/Codex status
- Enhanced Qwen 3.8 prompt processing speed on Apple Silicon

- `GET /api/show` now displays each model's thinking controls and defaults
- Added Nemotron H vision model support for Apple Silicon via MLX
- Resolved model pull issues from HuggingFace
- macOS app no longer reopens previously closed windows

**v0.34.2** (September 15, 2026)
- Introduced first-run setup with sign-in options or local-only mode
- Fixed excessive memory growth during extended generations with MLX speculative decoding
- Updated underlying llama.cpp

**v0.34.1** (September 14, 2026)
- MLX safetensors model creation no longer experimental
- Dramatically accelerated `/api/tags` performance (3.1s to 294ms)
- Enhanced MLX memory management on Apple Silicon
- Deprecated `typical_p` parameter for new models

**v0.34.0** (September 5, 2026)
- Ollama models now integrate directly with ChatGPT Desktop
- Improved structured output performance on Apple Silicon
- Added OpenAI-compatible client tool search and response compaction support

content.content:
# vLLM Recent Releases Summary

## v0.30.0 (September 22, 2024)
The latest release features 762 commits from 315 contributors. Key highlights include:

- **New models**: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with MXFP8 KV cache, GLM-5.3-Flash, K2-Horizon, and Cohere Compass
- **Fast Start**: Persistent GPU weight-cache daemon enabling faster engine restarts via IPC
- **Watermarking**: Gumbel-max watermarked generation with per-request opt-out capability
- **Model Runner V2**: Dual-batch overlap in eager mode and full CUDA graphs for microbatched steps
- **Performance**: Optimizations for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Kimi K3 models

## v0.29.0 (September 9, 2024)
This release contains 594 commits from 277 contributors. Major updates:

- **Model Runner V2 becomes default** for all models, completing its rollout
- **New models**: Hy4-preview (770B/49B-active MoE), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and GraniteSWA variants
- **Speculative decoding**: Per-request acceptance statistics in OpenAI API responses
- **RL weight sync**: New sharded backend for efficient distributed parameter updates
- **Breaking changes**: Ten deprecated architectures removed; Model Runner V1 deprecated

## v0.28.0 (August 26, 2024)
This release includes 584 commits from 270 contributors:

- **Kimi-K3 optimization**: Decode Context Parallel support and fused FlashKDA kernels
- **DeepSeek V4**: Sparse MLA end-to-end support with speculative decoding
- **Model Runner V2**: E/P/D disaggregation and weight offloading support
- **Tiered KV cache**: Disk offloading and secondary-tier manager support
- **Rust frontend**: Multimodal gRPC inference capabilities added

# Recent Hugging Face Transformers Releases

## Release 5.17.0 (September 9, 2024)

**Key Additions:**
- **HYV4**: A 780B-parameter mixture-of-experts model featuring Multi-head Latent Attention and sparse attention mechanisms
- **VibeVoice**: Framework for "synthesizing high-fidelity, long-form speech with multiple speakers"
- **NeoMME**: Efficient 260M-800M parameter multimodal encoders for text and image processing
- **Fun-ASR-Nano**: 800M-parameter speech recognition supporting Chinese, English, and Japanese
- **KimiLinear**: Hybrid linear attention architecture with Kimi Delta Attention
- **Canary**: Multilingual speech recognition and translation model
- **NeuCodec**: Neural audio codec with finite scalar quantization

**Major Fixes:** Generation improvements, cache bug corrections, kernel support enhancements, and vision rotary embedding standardization.

## Release v5.16.1 (August 26, 2024)

**Highlight:** GLM-5.3-Flash introduction—"the first natively multimodal model" in the GLM series with 320B total/18B active parameters, delivering performance "approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding benchmarks."

## Release v5.16.0 (August 26, 2024)

**New Models:**
- Qwen4-Exp, GraniteSpeech5, Step3p7, CohereCompass, ESMC, ESMFold2

**Major Changes:** DTensor-native tensor-parallel backend implementation, SDPA support for wav2vec2 models.

## Release v5.15.0 (August 10, 2024)

**Additions:** Meta Muse Glimmer (30B multimodal), GraniteMoeSWA, GraniteSWA, A.X-K1, A.X-K2, Cosmos3 Edge

**Improvements:** Attention optimizations, vision preprocessing acceleration, cache refinements.

# Recent Releases of anthropic-sdk-python

Here are the most recent releases with their dates and key changes:

## v1.8.0 (September 22, 2026)
**Latest Release**

### Key Features:
- Support for **claude-opus-5-5** model
- **Inline tool definitions**
- **MCP tool-list pinning** (beta)

### Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Python 3.13 crash at exit when stream is left open
- `add_tools()` now takes effect immediately
- Improved tool runner parameter handling

---

## v1.7.0 (September 18, 2026)

### Key Features:
- Added `group` with `display_name` to rate limits
- New `compact_before_next_turn()` method for tool runner
- Improved union type handling (`X | Y` syntax)

### Bug Fixes:
- Fixed `Retry-After` header handling for values above 60 seconds
- Connection error retries in async client
- Multiple `anthropic-beta` header value joining

---

## v1.6.0 (September 15, 2026)

### Key Features:
- Auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents
- **Compaction parameter** and signed compaction blocks (beta)
- Async credential token provider support
- `url_sources` added to web fetch tool

### Bug Fixes:
- Improved retry handling for connection errors
- Fixed Retry-After validation

---

## v1.5.0 (September 10, 2026)

### Key Features:
- `Message.to_param()` and `BetaMessage.to_param()` methods
- Tool objects can be passed directly to `messages.create()`, `parse()`, `stream()`, and `count_tokens()`
- New credential error types

### Bug Fixes:
- Fixed credentials file permission validation
- Tool input JSON partial blocks removed from content

---

## v1.0.0 (August 20, 2026)

### ⚠️ BREAKING CHANGES:
- **Upgrade to httpx2** with several minor breaking changes
- See MIGRATION.md for upgrade details

---

**Navigation:** Multiple pages of releases available; v1.8.0 is the current latest release.

# Recent PyTorch Releases

## PyTorch 2.14.0 (September 2, 2024)
Key highlights include NVGEMM kernels for Inductor, `torch.switch` for multi-way branching, declarative dynamic shapes via `@dynamic_spec`, experimental complex tensor support in `torch.compile`, and a rewritten NCCL backend preview.

## PyTorch 2.13.0 (July 8, 2024)
Major features: FlexAttention on Apple Silicon with "up to ~12x speedup," CuTeDSL backend for Inductor, `nn.LinearCrossEntropyLoss` reducing memory usage, torchcomms distributed backend, and FSDP2 communication overlap optimization.

## PyTorch 2.12.1 (June 18, 2024)
Focused bug-fix release addressing nondeterministic outputs with FLASH_ATTN on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, illegal memory access in Triton convolution kernels, and storage offset issues.

## PyTorch 2.12.0 (May 13, 2024)
Highlights: batched linalg.eigh on CUDA achieving "up to 100x faster" performance, unified `torch.accelerator.Graph` API, Microscaling quantization export support, and fused Adagrad optimizer.

## PyTorch 2.11.0 (March 23, 2024)
Features differentiable collectives, FlexAttention with FlashAttention-4 backend on Hopper/Blackwell GPUs, comprehensive MPS operator expansion, RNN/LSTM GPU export, and XPU graph support.

Here's the digest — biggest stuff first:

**Frontier model war heated up this week**
- Anthropic shipped **Claude Opus 5.5** the same week OpenAI dropped a *dual* GPT‑6 release ("Sol" and "Luna"), triggering a pricing shakeout — good rundown by Simon Willison: [Claude Opus 5.5, GPT‑6 Sol, GPT‑6 Luna, and a new price war](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/22/claude-opus-5-5-gpt-6/).
- The Anthropic SDK already added support: `anthropic-sdk-python` [v1.8.0](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases) adds `claude-opus-5-5`, inline tool defs, and beta MCP tool-list pinning.
- Simon also covered Meta's new agentic assistant in [Muse looks cute, but looks are deceiving](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/25/muse/), and Google's [Gemini 3.8 TTS playground](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/23/gemini-tts/) (2,000+ voices).

**HN front page today** — agent/tooling fatigue is the theme:
- [Plan mode is dead](https://www.aymannadeem.com/artificial/intelligence,/developer/tools/2026/09/24/plan-mode-is-dead.html) (571 pts) — coding-agent workflow critique.
- [DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22978) (311 pts) — new DeepSeek arXiv paper, HN-discussed.
- [How to keep enjoying programming in a world of LLMs](https://discourse.haskell.org/t/how-to-keep-enjoying-programming-in-a-world-of-llms/14705) (312 pts).
- [How I changed teaching after AI did all my homework](https://thelastsoftwareengineer.substack.com/p/how-i-changed-teaching-after-ai-managed) (275 pts).
- [Microsoft abandons personal AI chatbot race with Copilot reboot](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-25/microsoft-abandons-personal-ai-chatbot-race-with-copilot-reboot) (153 pts).

**Interconnects (Nathan Lambert)** — open-model/policy focus this week:
- [The current balance of power in open models](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/the-current-balance-of-power-in-open-models) (congressional testimony writeup).
- [Why I still haven't bought into true RSI](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/why-i-still-havent-bought-into-true-rsi) — pushback on recursive-self-improvement hype.
- Podcast: [Debating RSI, the US‑China gap, and jaggedness with JS Denain (Epoch AI)](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/debating-rsi-us-china-gap-jaggedness).

**Hugging Face / transformers**
- `transformers` [v5.17.0](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases) adds HYV4 (780B MoE), VibeVoice (multi-speaker TTS), Kimi Linear, Canary-1B-v2 ASR, NeuCodec, plus generation/cache/quantization fixes.
- Optimum Intel 2.2 + OpenVINO GenAI 2026.4 for local deployment — see [HF blog](https://huggingface.co/blog).

**Local-inference stack, moving fast as usual**
- `llama.cpp`: dozens of commits/day today — notable ones include SYCL FWHT kernels, CUDA FlashAttention tuning for head sizes 40–112, and stricter param-parsing error handling. [Releases](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases).
- `vllm` [v0.30.0](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases): adds DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash (MXFP8 KV cache), GLM‑5.3‑Flash, K2‑Horizon; new persistent GPU weight-cache daemon for faster restarts; watermarked generation.
- `ollama` [v0.40.0](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases) (pre-release): models now run on **MLX by default on Apple Silicon**; recent point releases improved structured-output speed and HF pull reliability.
- `pytorch` 2.14.0 remains latest stable (Sept 2): NVGEMM kernels for Inductor, `torch.switch`, experimental complex-tensor `torch.compile` support. [Releases](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/releases).

**arXiv (cs.CL/cs.LG/cs.AI)** — nothing single paper dominated cs.AI today beyond the DeepSeek DSec paper above; browse the raw feeds if you want to skim: [cs.LG](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.LG/recent) · [cs.CL](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.CL/recent) · [cs.AI](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent).

**Not found today:** no new posts on Lilian Weng's blog or fresh LocalLLaMA-Lemmy threads surfaced in search — worth checking [lemmy.world/c/localllama](https://lemmy.world/c/localllama@kbin.social) directly since Lemmy isn't well-indexed.
